messages:
sam: Heads-up: scheduling deferred reboot window for pool raptor-2 tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: staggered 10-node cordon -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon. Expected capacity loss ~15% during window.
priya: Which tenants will be affected? Any VIPs? Can we pre-seed caches to reduce cold-starts?
liam: If NVLINK flaps we should keep a 2-node canary. Health check to run on reboot:
```bash
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9000/health | jq .ok
```
sam: Affected cohorts: raptor-2-A/B (10 nodes total). VIP customers (acme, probeai) are on reserved lanes; SEs notified. We'll throttle new job scheduling during the window.
marie: Ops-bot scheduled maintenance job created.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance mnt-67234 | pool=raptor-2 | start=01:00 UTC | window=2h | nodes=10
gabby-oncall: I'll be oncall and watching dashboards (infra-monitor, request-latency). Abort criteria: error_rate >2% OR available_gpu_capacity <70%.
sam: Runbook (rapid):
```bash
for n in ${NODES}; do
  kubectl cordon $n
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
  ssh $n sudo reboot
  # wait for node to rejoin, run smoke tests
  kubectl uncordon $n
done
```
priya: Cost hit estimate? How much backfill from spot?
sam: We'll backfill up to 6 spot nodes for ~45m peak -> estimated delta ~$1.2k for the window. I'll put a charge note to finance.
liam: Can we prewarm KV cache on the two warm nodes to avoid cold-token regen? Suggest script:
```bash
/usr/local/bin/kv-prewarm --pool raptor-2 --seed 2
```
marie: Notified SEs + updated /status page draft. Will post final comm 30m before start.
ops-bot: Maintenance reminder in 30m
priya: Ack, I'll coordinate customer comms and keep an eye on cost tags.
sam: cool. will post final playbook link in 15m. ping me if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:
